findings.note: MLB.com's Game 1 preview (Oct 22): the Rays held back ace Rasmussen and are starting Nick Martinez against Misiorowski, who led MLB in ERA (1.80), Ks and WHIP. Milwaukee's bullpen has a 1.33 postseason ERA. The Rays are only missing McClanahan, and Woodruff is Milwaukee's open question.

CBS/SportsLine lists Brewers -198 / Rays +162, so the +165 offered is barely better than the market. Milwaukee went 59-26 at home and Martinez has a 6.10 ERA in his last five games vs MIL. The model's free pick is Over 6.5; its moneyline side is paywalled.

VSiN's analyst leans Rays +162 as a value play because the line looks too big. Reasons given: Misiorowski's high pitch counts this October and Martinez's sinker against Milwaukee's weakness on sinkers. The writer still expects the Brewers to win, and the Rays were only 43-38 on the road.
